request.state:
L01: Fill the kettle between the marks on the window.
L02: Never fill it above the upper mark.
L03: Set it on its base and press the switch down.
L04: The switch lifts when the water boils.
L05: Lift the kettle straight up off the base.
L06: Pour away from yourself.
L07: Empty the kettle if it will stand for a day.
L08: Descale it once a month in hard water.
L09: Use a descaler sold for kettles and follow its own instructions.
L10: Never put the kettle or its base in water.
L11: Wipe the outside with a damp cloth.
L12: Have a damaged cord replaced before the kettle is used again.
